title: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs via Path Selection (ACL 2024 Findings)
summary: This community centers on the paper 'Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Large Language Models via Path Selection,' published in the Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL) 2024. The work was proposed by a collaborative team of five researchers: Haochen Liu, Song Wang, Yaochen Zhu, Yushun Dong, and Jundong Li. The method focuses on integrating knowledge graphs with large language models through a specific path selection mechanism.
key_findings: The core contribution is a method titled 'Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Large Language Models via Path Selection.'
The paper was published in the Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics, ACL 2024, held in Bangkok, Thailand, and virtually from August 11-16, 2024.
Haochen Liu is identified as a proposer of the Path Selection method.
Song Wang is identified as a proposer of the Path Selection method.
Yaochen Zhu is identified as a proposer of the Path Selection method.
Yushun Dong and Jundong Li are also identified as proposers of the method.
